description: Solana priority-fee estimator from getRecentPrioritizationFees (last ~150 slots), globally or for the accounts your transaction writes to: min / p25 / median / p75 / p90 / p95 / max in micro-lamports per compute unit (all slots and non-zero slots), suggested low / medium / high / very-high compute-unit prices, and the resulting fee in lamports and SOL for your compute-unit limit and signature count. Public Solana RPC, read-only. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/sol-priority-fees

accounts.description: Writable accounts of your transaction (base58), up to 64; empty = global fees

computeUnits.description: Compute-unit limit used for the cost estimate

signatures.description: Signatures in the transaction (5000 lamports base fee each)
